rationale: The assistant correctly led with cleaning the condenser and door filter, matched the hidden truth, and closed with a sound interpretation of the customer's test results plus sensible maintenance advice. The first reply was front-loaded with heater/thermostat/NTC content and an offer to guide multimeter testing behind the back panel (unplugged, with an engineer alternative), which goes slightly beyond the user-maintenance boundary and was premature before cleaning, though properly conditional on a cold drum. Minor assumption that the customer used 'Cupboard Dry' was never stated by them, but no diagnostic claims were invented and no parts were pushed.
